subject.title: fix(codex): expose assistant completion idle timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.turnAssistantCompletionIdleTimeoutMs` as a public operator setting?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and proven, but OpenClaw policy sets a high bar for another persistent config knob and code review cannot decide whether this debugging and operational control is worth the long-term compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept the public timer
options.body: Keep the additive setting with its existing default and merge after the current head's required checks pass.

options.title: Keep the timer internal
options.body: Decline the permanent config contract and close the PR while retaining the existing direct runtime option for harness-only callers.

recommendation.title: Accept the public timer
recommendation.body: Keep the additive setting with its existing default and merge after the current head's required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Direct commits and force-pushes on the current head make steipete the clearest available owner to confirm whether the public contract is intentional.
